title: Piercing Statue Trio #008 (쓰리쿼터 · [쓰리쿼터·P25 집중형·내용물·사파이어+수정 조각·메이크업 지뢰계] ; [쓰리쿼터·P8 집중형·수조·반딧불이 밤·메이크업 프렌치레드립] ; [쓰리쿼터·P50 정의형·수조·장미 정원·메이크업 데코라])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. THREE women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, cool ash-grey hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge antique-brass bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, three smaller antique-brass rings, two thick antique-brass bars and a small antique-brass stud up to the top; one small antique-brass stud sits in the right ear; four antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small antique-brass rings pass through the left nostril and a thick antique-brass septum ring hangs below the nose; a antique-brass hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a antique-brass snake-bite ring beside it and a small antique-brass ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a antique-brass Medusa stud sits above the lips; a antique-brass labret stud and a small antique-brass ring sit on the chin; three small antique-brass studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is ONE solid, continuous block of deep blue sapphire crystal, with fine silky needle inclusions forming a soft star-like shimmer, near-midnight navy where thickest and pale cornflower at every thin edge, carved as one uniform sculpted mass, never hollow, never split down the centre. Yet suspended deep within this solid material, visible through it exactly like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are dozens of small, jagged clear quartz shards like frozen lightning bolts, each one a brighter, sharper facet than the glass around it, spread naturally from her chest down through her belly, hips and both thighs, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity, no hollow chamber and no liquid around it — the material itself grew solid around them. The material reads as one unbroken solid mass throughout; the embedded shapes are simply what is visible deep inside it, not a separate vessel. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult French woman — fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, deep dark brown hair styled in a short pixie cut. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge antique-brass stud hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, two smaller antique-brass rings and a small antique-brass stud at the top; two antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer end of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a small antique-brass ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small sapphires set into the metal.
#2 Physique: A still-visible cinched waist beneath a full soft chest, wide curving hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Her shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets the neck. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a warm summer night: hundreds of small glowing fireflies and a scatter of tiny floating paper lanterns drifting in the clear water that fills her body, from her chest down through her thighs. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and sealed shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#3: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick mixed-metal septum ring with a smaller mixed-metal ring above it and two mixed-metal rings through each nostril; a straight mixed-metal bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a mixed-metal Medusa stud above the lips; a big mixed-metal hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a mixed-metal labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small mixed-metal studs along each jaw; a curved row of small mixed-metal studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized mixed-metal hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine mixed-metal chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#3 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#3 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Her shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets the neck. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a rose garden at dawn: red and white roses among dark green leaves, a few drifting petals, standing in the clear water that fills her body, denser near the chest and thinning toward the thighs. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and sealed shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a pale lilac on one side and a soft mint on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
